title: Finite Q3 noncommuting cubic-multiplier order stress

adversarial_review.check: The right and left products are formed separately; no commutation of q_x^3 with the spectral power is assumed.
The centered weighted energy proxy is shifted to the declared positive floor before its negative fractional power is evaluated.
The floor is a manifest input and is checked on every declared row; it is not fitted from the observed minimum.
The commutator norm is checked against the two orientation norms by the triangle inequality, with the state-weighted four-leg analogue checked independently.
The 28 rows and three beta values are a declared finite grid; their positive minimum is not a volume-uniform lower bound.
The order stress does not establish a common core, thermodynamic dynamics, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean proves a small exact rational matrix order witness and bookkeeping only; Q3 spectra, unbounded domains and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: On the declared finite Q3 edge, square and 2x3 grids, both cubic-multiplier orientations differ by a nonzero operator commutator and satisfy the recorded norm triangle bounds for every source pair and beta.
qft_interface.open: A common-core cubic embedding, source/beta/volume-uniform direct D and delta-D estimate, split-history completion, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No TECT production owner, heat_root_incidence, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

no_overclaim: This is a finite order-sensitivity and noncommutation audit. It prevents an invalid orientation swap in later QFT estimates but neither proves nor disproves an infinite-volume cubic multiplier embedding.
